oracle: CASA task and casacore table reader

smoothcal.scope: Time windows, selected fields, mean and median, complex phase tracking, real delays, flags, uncertainties, in-place updates and rate-aware fringe solutions. Includes saved table views, required scalar paths, blank selectors, boolean duration, staged spectral-window flags, and actively locked destination rejection.

rerefant.scope: Ranked and strict references, previous-good continuity, nearest fallback, flags, multiple channels, single-polarization coverage, in-place updates and refusal of unsupported delays. Includes saved table views, unavailable or duplicate reference rows, and frequency-dependent and LLS leakage tables.
